block.goal: Move the selected cluster of related failable functional interfaces into the failable subpackage to reduce surface area of the top-level function package.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.function.failable if it does not already exist.
Move FailableConsumer to the failable subpackage to colocate failable functional interfaces.
Move FailableBiConsumer to the failable subpackage to keep binary and consumer variants together.
Move FailableRunnable to the failable subpackage to group runnable-style failable interfaces with other failable types.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.

package org.apache.commons.lang3.function.failable;

/**
 * A functional interface like {@link Runnable} that declares a kind of {@link Throwable}.
 *
 * @param <E> The kind of {@link Throwable}.
 * @since 3.11
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface FailableRunnable<E extends Throwable> {

    /**
     * Runs the function.
     *
     * @throws E Thrown when the function fails.
     */
    void run() throws E;
}
